name: press-print
description: AI art direction and source-aware visual reconstruction with interactive direction selection, flat editorial composition, selective halftone, tactile collage, and strict source-text control.

interface.shortDescription: AI art direction for existing imagery
interface.longDescription: Press Print 2.0 reads a user-supplied image before reconstructing it. For vague requests, it can identify the source's strongest visual opportunity and present a small set of source-specific art-direction choices; for explicit requests, it executes directly without unnecessary setup. The established Press Print visual language remains intact: strongly flattened editorial composition, source-derived cropping and scale shifts, selective photographic retention, visible halftone and duotone, graphic fields, controlled tactile collage, and modernist hierarchy. Revisions preserve successful decisions rather than restarting from a random composition. Press Print adds no new typography by default, never invents or translates source text, and permits only exact wording explicitly supplied by the user.
defaultPrompt: Process this image with Press Print.
